opening.argument: The title identifies the video as a dance tutorial, and the visible performance shows three people moving in coordination. Those are direct signs of instruction, not a financial or data-collection solicitation. The class link and email contact in the description serve as promotional and contact information; nothing in the supplied evidence connects them to deceptive promises or required financial participation. The content is therefore best understood as a dance tutorial with ordinary contact details, without claiming anything about what happens beyond the video.
